entries.note: DOI resolves to Dmitrieva 1997 (PMID 9145801); quote verbatim in abstract. No IC trial (Evans 2011, NCT00999518, NCT01060254, EudraCT 2016-004138-12) reports an NGF/PD readout; untested holds. Abstract-level.
Quote verbatim (trkA-IgG 1 mg/kg). Cystitis models dosed sibling sequestrants only; no stated human exposure target or margin, so untested. See rule question on dose-efficacy coupling.
Quote verbatim in Dmitrieva 1997 abstract; Hu 2005 (PMID 15711368, REN1820 CYP cystitis) also verified. Correct model family; product_in_model false right.

Evans 2011 (PMID 21420111, epub 2011-03-21) quote verbatim; primary endpoint pain; NCT00601484 results posted 2021-05-13, -1.36 [-2.203,-0.510]. Micturition frequency, the cystometric analogue, did not move; source_calls_it 'partial' would be defensible.

AAC briefing (Feb 2012, Pfizer, FDA-hosted) quote verbatim (chronic visceral pain section). NCT00999518 (A4091035, n=205) caveat: 'terminated due to lack of efficacy of all doses ... interim analysis'; posted 2021-08-03. Fulranumab IC trial did report results (see missing).

Both quotes verbatim (sec 7.1 and the joint-safety discussion); briefing confirms FDA put IC studies on hold 16 Jul 2010. Tier 2 (AdCom briefing), imported_from OA correct; on-target harm a rodent could show (LaBranche 2017).

Koya 2023 (PMC9721442, received 2022-07-06) abstract quote verbatim; full text has no bladder/cystitis model. untested opening at 2016 proxy (EudraCT) is fine. Arthritis-pain model for an IC trial: model_kind would better read cross_indication (decision 8).

EU CTR quote verbatim; primary endpoint is change in average mean daily pain at wk 12; results first posted 2020-02-08, end 2019-03-21. Rodent data were candidate-selection work not motivated by the IC result, so contra not retro; 2022 pairing date OK.
Quote verbatim in Koya 2023 abstract (MIA-arthritis rats). Opening untested entry, 2016 proxy; correct as a separate track from the three-species toxicology.

entries.note: Quote verbatim, 0/56 vs 3/61 SAEs verified. The prediction is comparative (no edema vs IgG in arthritic joints); the 12-wk IC trial had no IgG arm, no arthritic joints, no joint imaging. Non-serious arthralgia 4/56 (7.1%) vs 2/61 (3.3%). Untested, not same.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4 safety cell: the stated prediction was lower joint harm than IgG in arthritic joints; a 12-week IC trial with no IgG arm, no arthritis and no joint imaging could not show it, so never compared.

entries.note: LaBranche 2017 (epub 2016-07-05) objective quote verbatim in abstract. Opening untested entry for the post-hoc rat MMT track; year 2016 by publication is fine.

Quote verbatim in abstract. Built after the 2010 RPOA hold, so retrodiction true; reproduced cartilage damage (prophylactic dosing) but not the hypotrophic bone response: retro with source_calls_it partial (decisions 10, 11).

missing: Wang H et al. 2017, BMC Urol 17:2, doi:10.1186/s12894-016-0193-z (PMID 28056917, epub 2017-01-05): fulranumab 9 mg SC in IC/BPS (NCT01060254, n=31), primary endpoint LS mean difference -0.2 [-1.52, 1.10], not significant; no joint-related SAE. The draft says this trial ended 'with no results'; it belongs in efficacy entry 3's patient_trials (no status change: underpowered, already contra) and the note should be corrected.

ASP6294 is a PEGylated Fab' (MAbs 2023, PMID 36458900, doi:10.1080/19420862.2022.2149055); the EU CTR record 2016-004138-12 (first posted 2020-02-08, women only, P=0.591, -0.2 [90% CI -0.84, 0.43]) confirms the draft's patient_trials quote and shows the female subgroup Nickel 2016 flagged was not confirmed prospectively.
rule_questions: Dose table row 'reached, failed, abandoned -> dose contra, derived_from efficacy' (and 'reached, worked -> same'): does it apply when no model ever stated an exposure target for any member drug? The draft keeps dose untested while efficacy goes same then contra; the rules do not say whether 'target reached' can be scored without a stated target.

Engagement: can a model's functional readout (cystometric voiding frequency in CYP cystitis) count as a downstream PD readout when the human trial measured its counterpart (micturition frequency, unchanged in Evans 2011)? If yes, engagement would be contra 2011 at readout_tier downstream; the draft scored it as a symptom endpoint.

Dating of efficacy entry 3: could not open the ClinicalTrials.gov history for NCT00999518 (API returned non-JSON). If the termination-for-interim-analysis text was public before Feb 2012, the year should be earlier; the rules do not say whether a registry termination reason without results counts as a public comparison.
